scenes.spoken_text: A finished part dimension may differ from its core cutting dimension. Specify grain, edge treatment and measurement stage, then calculate allowances from the defined construction.
scenes.caption: A finished part dimension may differ from its core cutting dimension. Specify grain, edge treatment and measurement stage, then calculate allowances from the defined construction.

scenes.display_title: Specify grain direction for each part
scenes.spoken_text: Place a grain arrow on the identified face. For adjacent fronts, state orientation and sequence when a continuous appearance is required. Rotating a rectangle in a cutting layout may save material but change grain. Do not assume the first scheduled dimension defines grain direction; record it separately.
scenes.caption: A grain arrow is independent of dimension order.

scenes.display_title: Calculate core size from defined edges
scenes.spoken_text: In this declared exercise, finished width is 400 mm and opposite edges each receive an assumed 1 mm band, with no other additions in that direction. Core width is 400 − 1 − 1 = 398 mm; one banded edge would give 399 mm. Label stage, edges and system. This geometric assumption is not a universal product recipe.
scenes.caption: Exercise only: 400 finished = 1 edge + 398 core + 1 edge.

scenes.spoken_text: Distinguish rough preparation stock from edge deductions and assembly clearances. Saw kerf affects sheet layout, not an automatic addition to each finished part. Record finished, core and rough-stage dimensions with reasons. A 402 mm schedule entry against a 400 mm drawing requires clarification of stage or revision, rather than an unexplained correction.
scenes.caption: Every dimensional difference needs a stage and reason.

scenes.spoken_text: Both exercise fronts finish at 400 mm width. P01 has two 1 mm opposite bands, giving a 398 mm core; P02 has one 1 mm band, giving 399 mm. Mark E1/E2, grain and measurement stage. A bare 400 mm entry does not establish the required cut size. Decision: schedule 398 and 399 mm as core sizes under the documented exercise assumptions.
scenes.caption: Decision: schedule 398 and 399 mm as core sizes under the documented exercise assumptions.
